description: Road Safety Camera Network - Top 50 cameras (Quarterly) is a dataset listed in Australian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Cameras Save Lives. This data provides quarterly lists of the top 50 cameras for speeding, red- light and unregistered vehicle fines. The address of the camera site and the number of infringements is provided for each camera. Coverage: Australia. The portal files it under the publisher Cameras Save Lives. Its tags are and, cars, speed, traffic cameras, unregistered vehicles. It offers 19 resource(s) in XLS, XLSX. The portal shows 2026-04-28 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-3.0-AU. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-au-portal.
